reviews.title: Great monitor, great deal
reviews.comment: Great value for a great monitor. Picture is terrific 4K, w good color and contrast. The BEST? Nope. But at this price, this pretty great screen becomes a bargain. Plus I can use my VESA arm. Also, I got mine “like new” and got a nice discount on what appeared to be a brand new monitor. No one ever bought a computer monitor for the speakers, but these are essentially nonexistent, so much so I had to turn the volume up all the way and then put my ear right up to the screen to even find them (on the bottom edge btw, presumably intended to bounce sound off the desk). My iPhone speakers sound better. Again, not a big deal since no monitor speakers are good, but some can at least add some fill to your setup. Not these.
reviews.author: BMC

reviews.title: Big Bang for Your Buck
reviews.comment: I bought this to replace an earlier, non-HDR version that I dropped. I'd just upgraded my video card anyway. I can't emphasize enough the quality of this monitor at the price point. It may not have the ultra-crisp look of monitors costing two or three times this (or more) but it certainly does the job(s) I want from it at this price point. Gaming: Elder Scrolls Online doesn't necessarily challenge the combination of RX760XT and this monitor, but the game looks great with the auto-HDR function. Photo Editing, the more important aspect for me, has taken on a new "flavor". Between upgrading from a RTX3060 to RX7600 XT and this monirot, images in Lightroom have a depth on this monitor that makes me want to try out some "crazy" editing functions that didn't look very satisfying on my old monitor.
reviews.author: Charles H. Black

reviews.title: Very good for the money
reviews.comment: Pleased with the quality of this monitor for the price.  I didn't notice that the stand is not height adjustable when ordering.  The bottom edge of the monitor is 4" above the surface of the desk.  Some may want to take note of that. The default color settings are complete garbage (everything is overblown, especially green) but are easily adjustable  to provide a good image.  Off axis viewing is pretty terrible with uneven brightness in the edges at merely 10 degrees off center.  Won't be a problem for me since I'm looking at them straight on.  The bezel looks razor thin out of the box but there is an unlit area (about 1/4") inside of the bezel that makes it appear a bit thicker when powered on.  Still a thinner overall bezel than my 12 year old Asus HD monitors.  If you are new to adjusting monitors, here are my adjusted settings (brightness 100, contrast 100, gamma 24, red 61, green 60, blue 85).  If off axis viewing wasn't so bad, I'd give it 5 stars.
reviews.author: Todd W. Carnes

reviews.comment: Great monitor. Works great and captures colors well
reviews.author: Jason

reviews.title: Great value for money.
reviews.comment: Great screen for the price - excellent value. Easy to set up. Color calibrated relatively easily (unlike other screens at the same price point). Good picture quality. Unobtrusive bezel. Clear and intuitive (single) menu button. Love the Vesa mount compatibility. I don't use the speakers so no comment on the audio. If you're looking for an inexpensive 4K screen.. this is a great contender.
